phase: AnyTour Design System 1.0 and site-wide visual unification are now priority #1. The technical refactor inventory remains important but is secondary to making the public site read as one coherent product. Production, lead-loss, incorrect-data and broken-user-journey defects still preempt all planned work. Search remains the protected product reference and must not regress while weaker editorial/public pages are migrated onto shared tokens, shell and rhythm.

target.rule: Do not raise product/visual scores from CI or refactor work alone; require production and representative visual evidence.

current_task.progress: PR #325 introduced one shared editorial rhythm layer through the canonical site-page shell instead of per-page fixes. It increases section separation, normalizes card/step/action rhythm and constrains long copy to a readable measure across /hot/, /contacts/, /how-to-buy/, /rb/, /country/ and representative country pages. All PR guards were green, production deploy 33300567702 passed public-page verification, unchanged lead-bridge verification and live search smoke, and production Visual standalone content live 33300650073 passed every covered route at 375/430/768/1024/1440. Representative production screenshots for mobile contacts/hot and desktop how-to-buy/country catalog were manually reviewed and showed coherent hierarchy without overflow or shell duplication. PR #326 then promoted the responsive content gap and readable copy measure into canonical Design System tokens; all PR checks were green, V2 deploy 33300796925 and standalone deploy 33300796910 were green, with search smoke preserved. Metrika, Tourvisor, lead contract, logo and legal/payment content were untouched.
current_task.next_action: Continue Design System 1.0 through the weakest remaining cross-page seams: audit homepage versus shared public-page primitives, header/navigation geometry and footer density across 375/430/768/1024/1440; then improve one shared primitive or weak page family at a time. Preserve the mature search/results/tour/lead path and use it as the interaction-quality reference without making editorial pages unnecessarily dense.

production_baseline.design_system_release: PR #325 shared editorial rhythm plus PR #326 canonical responsive content-gap and copy-measure tokens

work_order: audit homepage, shared editorial shell and search shell side-by-side at 375/430/768/1024/1440; fix repeated visual seams through shared primitives first
converge header/navigation geometry and active-state treatment without replacing the mature search header component until an atomic safe path exists
audit footer/community density and wrapping across public pages; fix only confirmed spacing, wrapping or hierarchy issues
continue migrating weak page families onto shared typography, spacing, card, button and breadcrumb primitives instead of page-specific overrides
audit homepage → country/destination → hot/search → results → selected tour → lead continuity and fix broken hierarchy or handoff seams
continue CI/dependency refactor in parallel only where it directly improves safe Design System iteration or removes verified duplication
preserve search/recovery/results/comparison/flight/price/fuel/lead regressions and verify every user-visible slice before deploy

deferred.reason: Visual compatibility is substantially aligned, but a full component swap remains deferred until an atomic extraction path and equivalent browser coverage make it safe.
Requires deliberate publication contract and reviewed content.
Legacy legal/payment content/requisites are not reconciled.
Separate DB/platform architecture; do not auto-merge without a fresh safety review.

continuation_policy.priority: production_broken > lead_loss > incorrect_data > broken_user_journey > design_system_sitewide_visual_unification > technical_refactor > content_seo > cosmetic_refactor
continuation_policy.on_no_traffic: ignore_as expected and continue product/design development
